title: Breaking Precedent (Leah Solivan, TaskRabbit founder) — 'This is the conversation I wish I had had when I was starting TaskRabbit'
summary: Leah Solivan — TaskRabbit founder, investor, board director — releases an Incorruptible episode on her Breaking Precedent podcast, framing the conversation as the one she wishes she'd had when starting TaskRabbit. Solivan is also a back-of-book endorser; this is the long-form follow-up.
blockquote: This is the conversation I wish I had had when I was starting TaskRabbit.
